# Credits

## Authorship

Mintal was written with Claude (Anthropic's coding assistant) from the product
specification in this repository. The author set the scope and the constraints, wrote and
revised the specification, made the product decisions, ran every build on real hardware
and decided what was wrong with it. Claude wrote the code.

Every commit carries a `Co-Authored-By: Claude` trailer, so the split is visible in
`git log` rather than resting on this note.

## Artwork

**None third-party.** Every visual in Mintal is generated by code in this repository:

- The twelve mints and the wilted sprig are drawn procedurally in
  `ui/components/MintArt.kt` from per-species botanical parameters in
  `assets/species.json` — leaf shape, leaf margin, growth habit, relative leaf size.
- The Grove is drawn in `ui/components/GroveCanvas.kt` from the layout computed in
  `domain/grove/GroveLayout.kt`.
- Charts are hand-drawn Compose canvas in `ui/components/Charts.kt`.
- The launcher icon, the notification icon and the leaf drawable are hand-written
  `VectorDrawable` XML in `app/src/main/res/drawable/`.

This is a deliberate placeholder for commissioned artwork, not a final state. When an
illustrator's set arrives it will be credited here, with its licence, from the first asset
added.

## Typography

System font families only (`FontFamily.Monospace` for numerals and headings,
`FontFamily.SansSerif` for body text). Nothing is downloaded at runtime; a bundled
typeface will be credited here when one is chosen.

## Botanical reference

The per-species traits that drive the drawings — leaf shape and margin, whether a leaf is
sessile or stalked, growth habit, and the form of the inflorescence — come from a photo
reference sheet the author compiled, with each photograph attributed to its source.

**The photographs themselves are not in this repository and are not shipped.** They were
consulted as reference only; their sources retain their own rights. What the app contains
is drawing parameters derived from observing them, which is the same relationship an
illustrator has to the plant on their desk.

## Botanical notes

The one-line notes in `assets/species.json` were written for this project from general
botanical knowledge of the genus *Mentha* — habit, leaf form, scent chemistry, hybrid
parentage — and are not copied from any single source. Corrections are welcome; a
biochemist's eye on them is welcome too.

## Study tips

The legend line that appears during a session alternates in-world flavour text with a
cited finding from the learning-science literature (`ui/session/LegendLines.kt`). The
citations are to the published work; the wording is ours. The claims are deliberately
limited to well-replicated findings — testing effect, spacing, interleaving,
self-explanation, sleep consolidation.
